title: Davenport District 14 schoolhouse: Dutch Hill–Taylor roads
summary: Approximate modern intersection proxy, not the school footprint or a meeting venue. A historical society photo caption places District 14 school at the Dutch Hill and Taylor roads junction circa 1915; its 1855 compilation likewise lists that junction. The ledger records Davenport 3 and 14 consolidating into 3 on September 4, 1915. Exact corner, historical road alignment, building continuity and shared source lineage remain unresolved.

title: Gregorytown former District 4 school: Fuller Hill and River
summary: Modern junction proxy for a former Gregorytown school, not a surveyed footprint or 1938 meeting place. Colchester Historical Society places a District 4 school at Fuller Hill and Back River roads and says it closed in 1921. NYS road centerlines place Fuller Hill and River Road junction here. Maps show multiple #4 sites and historical building/relocation sequence and exact corner remain unresolved. 1938 District 4 membership does not prove this school was then operating.
